# Devmarket

> Devmarket is a marketplace connecting clients and verified web developers across Africa. Clients post their web project briefs for free; developers subscribe to unlock contacts. No commission on projects.

## About
- Name: Devmarket
- URL: https://devvmarket.vercel.app
- Language: French (default), English
- Region: Africa (54 countries)
- Contact: contact@devmarket.com

## Key pages
- Home: https://devvmarket.vercel.app/
- Find a developer: https://devvmarket.vercel.app/dev
- Post a project: https://devvmarket.vercel.app/poster
- Briefs: https://devvmarket.vercel.app/briefs
- Agencies: https://devvmarket.vercel.app/agences
- Rankings: https://devvmarket.vercel.app/classement
- Pricing: https://devvmarket.vercel.app/abonnement
- FAQ: https://devvmarket.vercel.app/faq
- About: https://devvmarket.vercel.app/a-propos

## For developers
- Free registration, automatic profile activation at 100%.
- Subscription plans: free, Pro, Pro Max, Agency.
- Monthly contact quotas with bonus contacts from rankings.

## For clients
- Free project posting.
- Optional boost for visibility (7/14/30 days).
- Direct contact with developers, no commission.
